# Warlock AI Cli

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-cli`

> Drive vendor coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, …) as first-class @warlock.js/ai agents

## Skills

- [run-cli-agents](@warlock.js/ai-cli/run-cli-agents/SKILL.md): Run vendor coding CLIs headless as agents with @warlock.js/ai-cli. Triggers: `ai.cli`, `cli.claudeCode`, `cli.codex`, `cli.antigravity`, `cli.qwenCode`, `cli.kimi`, `cli.cursor`, `cli.copilot`, `cli.grok`, `cli.opencode`, `cli.amp`, `cli.droid`, `cli.mistralVibe`, `cli.aider`, `cli.reasonix`, `createCliAgent`, `CliSession`, `session.events`, `session.done`, `CliEvent`, `CliResult`, `sessionRef`, `resume`, `permission: "bypass"`, `CliMcpServers`, `home: "private"`, `inheritEnv`, `CliError`, `agent.model`, `cliModel`; 'run claude code from node', 'orchestrate codex / copilot / cursor as workers', 'stream a CLI agent's tool calls', 'resume a CLI session', 'cancel a coding CLI and its child processes', 'read token usage from a CLI run', 'give a CLI MCP servers without putting tokens in argv', 'use a CLI as an ai.agent model'; typical import `import { cli } from "@warlock.js/ai-cli"`. Skip: writing an adapter for another CLI — the `write-a-cli-adapter` topic; direct provider calls — the `run-ai-agent` topic of the `warlock-js-ai` skill.
- [write-a-cli-adapter](@warlock.js/ai-cli/write-a-cli-adapter/SKILL.md): Write a CliAdapter for a coding CLI that @warlock.js/ai-cli does not ship. Triggers: `CliAdapter`, `CliLaunchContext`, `CliLaunchPlan`, `CliStreamParser`, `cli.custom`, `createCliAgent`, `jsonLinesParser`, `stringField`, `numberField`, `usageOf`, `mcpServersJson`, `jsonFile`, `toToml`, `mapEffort`, `argvPrompt`, `promptFile`, `requirePrivateHome`, `unsupportedOption`, `createClaudeStreamParser`, `helpLists`, `missingFlags`, `requires`, `verification`; 'add a new coding CLI', 'support another agent CLI', 'parse a vendor JSONL stream', 'adapter for a new CLI version'; typical import `import { cli, jsonLinesParser, type CliAdapter } from "@warlock.js/ai-cli"`. Skip: using the built-in adapters — the `run-cli-agents` topic.
